title: PUT uses full-replace semantics
evidence: src/books_item_handler.erl:19 PUT runs the same books_validate:validate/1 as create and books_db:update/2 overwrites all columns, so an omitted year/isbn resets them to null (see test update_replaces_book asserting year => null)
suggestion: Acceptable PUT semantics; note for cross-run comparison that no PATCH/partial-update path exists

title: GET /books returns the full unpaginated collection
evidence: src/books_collection_handler.erl:16 list/1 returns every row; src/books_db.erl handle_call({list,...}) has no LIMIT/OFFSET
suggestion: Not required by the spec; fine for the task scope

title: Author filter is an exact case-insensitive match, not a substring
evidence: src/books_db.erl:70 WHERE author = ?1 COLLATE NOCASE (verified by test list_and_filter_by_author)
suggestion: Matches a reasonable reading of ?author=; note for comparison
